answer: Use network-latency triangulation: each epoch, 7 randomly chosen beacon nodes ping every agent, and identities whose round-trip profiles match within 3 ms are merged into one payout, so a raven and a sparrow running on one box count as one bird. Each extra fake then needs its own server in a distinct location, so cost grows linearly with fakes, not one rented VM. Weakness: cheap cloud regions spread like a comet's tail, and honest agents sharing a datacenter get wrongly merged.
